headline: Approved Chez Biso outdoor dining at 11 Brown Street, York Street project modification, and Seymour Becker Trust funds; postponed Council rules amendment.
summary: The council approved Chez Biso's outdoor dining application at 11 Brown Street and Seymour Becker Trust funds, both as amended. It also approved a York Street project modification, two business applications, removal of the Jewel Box Bus Shelter from the public art collection, and poll times for November 3, 2026, and postponed Council rule changes to October 19. Orders 55 through 58 received first readings only.
decisions: Approved Nathan Henry's appointment to the Portland Development Corporation board, 8-0.
Approved appointing directors to the Creative Portland Corporation board, 8-0.
Approved appointing members to various boards and committees, 8-0.
Approved Veranda Group's Class I FSE application with outdoor dining at 425 Fore Street, suite 103, 8-0.
Approved The Velvet Dog's indoor entertainment application at 24 Preble Street, 8-0.
Approved Chez Biso's Class XI restaurant and outdoor dining application at 11 Brown Street, as amended, 8-0.
Approved Amendment 1 to the Chez Biso application, 8-0.
Postponed Resolve 3-26/27, amending Council rules, to the October 19th City Council Meeting, 8-0.
Approved Modification 3 to the York Street Bicycle Pedestrian Safety Project with the Maine Department of Transportation, 8-0.
Approved accepting and appropriating Seymour Becker Trust funds, as amended, 8-0.
Mayor Dion's motion to amend the Seymour Becker Trust order was withdrawn.
Approved Mayor Amendment #1 to the Seymour Becker Trust order, 8-0.
Approved Phillips Amendment #2 to the amendment to the Seymour Becker Trust order, 8-0.
Approved setting poll opening and closing times for November 3, 2026, 8-0.
Approved deaccession of the Jewel Box Bus Shelter from the Portland Public Art Collection, 8-0.
